name: Spynel-S 6000 panoramic IR (HGH)
description: Passive rotating MWIR sensor that rebuilds a 360 deg thermal panorama every 2 s and cues itself. Wide-area search, no radar needed. UAS ranges are planning figures: HGH publishes DRI for people and vehicles only.

classifyRangeM.condition: RECOGNITION range for a HUMAN target, used only as a bound — PROXY, NOT A UAS FIGURE. HGH publishes Spynel-S 6000 human recognition at 2 km (Johnson criterion, STANAG). No UAS recognition or identification range exists in any source. 2000 m is used as a representative classification ring because it is the OEM's own recognition figure for the smallest published target class, which bounds a Group 1 UAS from above.
classifyRangeM.source: SPYNEL SERIES Wide Area Surveillance Solutions leaflet
classifyRangeM.note: Inventory records 2000 m (2 km) at MANUFACTURER_CLAIM (for the human figure) / INFERRED (as a UAS proxy) REPRESENTATIVE; the seed leaves the field null
